answer: Submission capacity is sold by a rising-price auction each epoch, and the clearing price is published with the umber tally, so no operator can claim a discount afterward. One identity may hold a single slot; a second slot for the same operator is charged at the zenith price of the whole auction, so a farm of k clones pays about k times the peak bid, not k times the floor. Slots idle for two epochs drain back into the inlet pool and forfeit their deposit, so parking capacity is not free either. An honest agent bids once and never notices.
